name: Muntin Cost Index — open-data catalog
description: Every published Muntin Cost Index dataset with its license, source, and the honesty note that travels with the data. Rights split (ADR-015/ADR-017): raw US-government passthroughs are CC0 (public domain); Muntin's value-added compilations are CC BY 4.0.

datasets.title: US import value by HS code (2010–2025)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: US Census Bureau — International Trade (imports/HS)
datasets.honesty_note: General US import value (GEN_VAL_MO) by HS code, monthly, nominal — value, never volume (unpublished at HS6). Public domain.

datasets.title: US import value by source country (2025)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: US Census Bureau — International Trade (imports by CTY)
datasets.honesty_note: US import value by HS code × source country, 2025. Real countries only. A supply-diversity fact, never a risk forecast. Public domain.

datasets.title: US domestic export value by HS6 (2010–2025)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: US Census Bureau — International Trade (exports/HS, DF=1)
datasets.honesty_note: US domestic exports (DF=1, US-produced goods excluding foreign re-exports) by HS6, monthly, nominal value. Public domain.

datasets.title: US domestic production, farm price, area, yield
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service — QuickStats (SURVEY)
datasets.honesty_note: National annual production ($ + volume), farm-gate price received, area, yield. Farm price is farm-gate — a distinct point in the chain, never the wholesale reference. Public domain.

datasets.title: US corn & soybean crop condition (weekly)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service — Crop Progress (SURVEY)
datasets.honesty_note: National weekly share of the corn and soybean crop rated in each condition class (very poor..excellent), by year and week — the feed-complex health signal. An observed present-state rating, never a forecast. Public domain.

datasets.title: US energy carriers — diesel, natural gas, electricity
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: US Energy Information Administration
datasets.honesty_note: Monthly No.2 diesel retail, Henry Hub natural gas spot, US average retail electricity. Public domain.

datasets.title: Observed weather at import growing regions (GHCN-Daily)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: NOAA NCEI — Global Historical Climatology Network (Daily)
datasets.honesty_note: Daily TMIN/TMAX/PRCP (tenths) at representative stations in import-origin growing regions, 1991–present. Observed weather, never a forecast. Public domain.

datasets.title: CPC Oceanic Niño Index (ENSO regime)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center
datasets.honesty_note: The observed El Niño / La Niña (ENSO) regime index, 3-month seasons. Observed, never a forecast. Public domain.

datasets.title: US commercial fish landings by species (1950–2024)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: NOAA Fisheries — FOSS commercial landings
datasets.honesty_note: US commercial (wild-caught) landings — value ($, nominal ex-vessel) and pounds (round weight) — by species and state, for the restaurant-relevant seafood categories. Confidential rows are withheld (null), never zero-padded. Public domain.

datasets.title: US per-capita food availability by commodity
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: USDA Economic Research Service — Food Availability (Per Capita) Data System
datasets.honesty_note: Per-capita food availability (pounds/person/year) and the underlying supply-and-use series by commodity and year, across 12 food groups. A supply-side proxy for consumption, never a measured intake, never a price, never a forecast. Public domain.

datasets.title: US meat price spreads — farm/wholesale/retail (1970–)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: USDA Economic Research Service — Meat Price Spreads
datasets.honesty_note: Monthly national-average farm value, wholesale value, retail value, and the spreads between them for beef, pork, and broilers, in cents per pound of retail equivalent. The retail figure is national-average grocery retail, never a delivered or menu price; the spreads are documented statistics, never a forecast. Public domain.

datasets.title: US Food Dollar Series — farm share + marketing chain (1993–2023)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: USDA Economic Research Service — Food Dollar Series
datasets.honesty_note: How each dollar Americans spend on domestically-produced food splits across the marketing chain (farm production, processing, packaging, transport, wholesale, retail, foodservices, energy, …) in cents per domestic food dollar, plus the farm share. A national macro statistic, never a per-ingredient claim, never a forecast. Public domain.

datasets.title: FDA food recalls tagged to tracked ingredients (2020–)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: US Food and Drug Administration — openFDA Food Enforcement
datasets.honesty_note: Dated FDA food-enforcement recalls whose product text names a tracked ingredient, each row tagged with the matched ingredient slug (a whole-word product-text match, not a supply or price link). A documented food-safety record surfaced on its own — co-occurrence, never a cause, never a magnitude, never joined to a price. FDA-regulated foods only (USDA/FSIS meat, poultry, and egg recalls are absent). Public domain.

datasets.title: County restaurant-industry wages & employment (QCEW, 2019–)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics — Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
datasets.honesty_note: Quarterly average weekly wage, establishments, and employment for the private food-services industry (NAICS 722 & 7225) in Montgomery County, MD. A descriptive county industry average — never a per-plate labor cost, never blended into the food index, the pressure math, or the Vendor Benchmark reference, never a forecast. Public domain.

datasets.title: US food-services monthly retail sales (MARTS, 2015–)
datasets.rights: US Government work — public domain (17 USC 105); redistributed verbatim.
datasets.source: US Census Bureau — Monthly Retail Trade Survey (via FRED)
datasets.honesty_note: Monthly retail sales for Food Services & Drinking Places (NAICS 722), $ millions, seasonally adjusted and not, via FRED's public mirror. Observed sales — never a demand forecast; the most recent month is a provisional advance estimate subject to revision. A descriptive demand backdrop, never blended into the food index, the pressure math, or the Vendor Benchmark reference. Public domain.

datasets.title: Ingredient State Record (fused corpus)
datasets.rights: Compilation © Muntin Cost Index, licensed CC BY 4.0. Attribution: "Muntin Cost Index, muntin.digital".
datasets.source: Muntin Cost Index — fuses Census imports/exports, NASS, and internal price/yield/events layers
datasets.honesty_note: One present-state record per ingredient. Descriptive, never a forecast; wholesale a market-direction reference, never a delivered price; import value never volume; reliance an apparent-consumption proxy; co-occurrence never cause. Underlying import/export/production columns are US-gov public domain; the fused compilation is CC BY 4.0.

datasets.title: Energy backdrop (each carrier vs its own range)
datasets.rights: Compilation © Muntin Cost Index, licensed CC BY 4.0. Attribution: "Muntin Cost Index, muntin.digital".
datasets.source: Muntin Cost Index — computed from US EIA public-domain series
datasets.honesty_note: Each energy carrier read against its own multi-decade range (percentile, band, YoY). A coincident site-wide backdrop, never a per-ingredient driver, never a forecast. Underlying series are US-gov public domain; the computed reads are CC BY 4.0.

datasets.title: Crop-condition backdrop (corn & soybean feed complex)
datasets.rights: Compilation © Muntin Cost Index, licensed CC BY 4.0. Attribution: "Muntin Cost Index, muntin.digital".
datasets.source: Muntin Cost Index — computed from USDA NASS public-domain crop-progress series
datasets.honesty_note: Each feed crop's good-to-excellent share read against its own same-week history in prior seasons (percentile, band). A coincident site-wide backdrop on the feed complex, never a per-ingredient driver, never a forecast. Underlying series are US-gov public domain; the computed reads are CC BY 4.0.

datasets.title: US domestic wild-landings by seafood group
datasets.rights: Compilation © Muntin Cost Index, licensed CC BY 4.0. Attribution: "Muntin Cost Index, muntin.digital".
datasets.source: Muntin Cost Index — computed from NOAA Fisheries FOSS public-domain landings
datasets.honesty_note: US commercial WILD landings (value + pounds) summed to national by seafood species group — the domestic pair for each seafood import stream. A wild-catch figure set beside a largely-farmed import stream: the wild-vs-farmed seam is named per group, never collapsed into a clean apparent-consumption share; negligible wild fisheries are flagged. Underlying series are US-gov public domain; the computed reads are CC BY 4.0.

datasets.title: Per-capita availability mapped to tracked ingredients
datasets.rights: Compilation © Muntin Cost Index, licensed CC BY 4.0. Attribution: "Muntin Cost Index, muntin.digital".
datasets.source: Muntin Cost Index — computed from USDA ERS public-domain availability series
datasets.honesty_note: USDA ERS per-capita availability (lbs/person/year) mapped to tracked ingredients — the VOLUME companion to the value-based reliance read (how many pounds per person are available domestically). A supply-side proxy for consumption, published at the commodity level (a variety/cut carries its parent commodity figure), never a measured intake, never a price, never a forecast. Underlying series are US-gov public domain; the mapping/compilation is CC BY 4.0.

datasets.title: Protein price chain (farm → wholesale → retail)
datasets.rights: Compilation © Muntin Cost Index, licensed CC BY 4.0. Attribution: "Muntin Cost Index, muntin.digital".
datasets.source: Muntin Cost Index — computed from USDA ERS Meat Price Spreads
datasets.honesty_note: The documented national-average farm → wholesale → retail chain for beef, pork, and broilers, with the spreads and the downstream-markup share (how much of the farm-to-retail spread sits above wholesale — downstream of where a kitchen buys). Retail is national-average grocery retail, never a delivered or menu price; a documented spread, never a forecast. Underlying series are US-gov public domain; the computed reads are CC BY 4.0.

datasets.title: The Food Dollar — farm share + marketing-chain split
datasets.rights: Compilation © Muntin Cost Index, licensed CC BY 4.0. Attribution: "Muntin Cost Index, muntin.digital".
datasets.source: Muntin Cost Index — computed from USDA ERS Food Dollar Series
datasets.honesty_note: The farm share of the US food dollar (~16¢) and the marketing-chain split (foodservices, retail, processing, wholesale, farm production, energy, …) summing to 100, per year. The sitewide macro bookend to the per-protein meat chain. A national macro statistic, never a per-ingredient claim, never a forecast. Underlying series are US-gov public domain; the computed reads are CC BY 4.0.

datasets.title: Food recalls indexed to tracked ingredients
datasets.rights: Compilation © Muntin Cost Index, licensed CC BY 4.0. Attribution: "Muntin Cost Index, muntin.digital".
datasets.source: Muntin Cost Index — openFDA recalls keyed to the tracked-ingredient taxonomy
datasets.honesty_note: openFDA food recalls compiled onto Muntin's tracked-ingredient taxonomy: per ingredient, the count of distinct recall events (event_id) by FDA severity class, the raw notice count, and the five most recent notices. The honest headline is distinct events, never the notice count; co-occurrence, never a cause, never joined to a price. The underlying recalls are US-gov public domain; the selection onto the tracked taxonomy is CC BY 4.0.
